author: OriginaI
body:
(This took me a hour to make so please be nice!) 
You may NOT take any of these ideas unless given permission by the owner of the idea, if you would like to submit a idea just put it down in chat. 
Thank you, Ebirdy9

==My Ideas==

The Walls Kit Ideas! 
1: Ultimate Pyro -  A stick or a wooden sword with fire aspect - Or a enchantment book with fire aspect 1. 

2: Teleporter : Comes with 1 ender pearl 

3: Farmer : Comes with a hoe,  and some seeds of different kind. 

4: Fisherman : Comes with a fishing pole with the enchant luck of the sea 1 -  people can use this in pvp to. 

5: Luck - You get a random item from a list of items,  they could be good,  they could be bad! 

6: Bird - kinda like a parachute but you glide down like a bird, kinda like the paper airplane mod. 

Nexus Kit Ideas  :

1: Popper : the kit from elimination but with a stone sword. And regular leather armour

2: Fisherman : Comes with a wooden sword and a fishing pole,  the main point is not to fish ofc,  the fishing pole is a pvp item. 

3: Druggy - You have nausea 1,  comes with stone sword and full leather but iron chest and iron leggings

4: Zombie - Iron shovel, enchanted with sharpness 1 and knock back 1, and also gives you speed 1, Full leather Armour included

5: Wizard - Blaze rod, when you right click it it either shoots a fireball(5 second delay)  or shoots 3 arrows with a 1 second delay between them,  and then a 5 second delay to shoot the arrows again,  and it comes with a gold sword.  And full gold Armour. 

6: Evil Snowman - 5 snowballs (5 second delay) when hit you get nausea 1 and slowness 1 for 3 seconds,  Comes with a wood sword, and full leather except for a iron helmet. 

==END of my ideas==

==OTHER ideas not by me! ==
